# BBQ NANNY 烧烤管家

> BBQ supplies delivery in Malaysia / 马来西亚烧烤食材与烧烤用品配送。Pre-marinated frozen skewers, meatballs & fish cakes, shabu sliced meats, hotpot soup base, BBQ grills, portable gas cookers, charcoal, sauces and disposable party supplies — all in one WhatsApp order. Also BBQ party packages (BBQ + hotpot) for 6–8 and 10–15 pax, ideal for company team building, birthdays, family gatherings, open house and camping.
